title: Validity, Sparse Holes, and Breadth in Language Generation: Banach Density, Topology, and Geometry
summary: Language generation in the limit, rooted in work of Gold and Angluin and revived by Kleinberg and Mullainathan, studies generation under minimal assumptions: an adversary enumerates strings from an unknown target language $K$, and an algorithm must eventually generate unseen strings from $K$. A central question is the tension between validity and breadth: can a generator avoid hallucination while covering the hidden language broadly?
